query: Turn this page into a Power Apps screen: /workspace/invx-account-closure/pages/sales-screen-1.html (tokens in assets/tailwind-config.js, styles in assets/app.css)
notes: Regression fixture. 02_Sales_InitialContact.pa.yaml is the screen that actually compiled from this page. Compare the generated output against it structurally, not line by line.
expected_behavior: Skill triggers without the user naming pa.yaml or the skill
Reads assets/tailwind-config.js and assets/app.css, not just the markup, and says so
Uses only the nine catalog control types with exact version strings
Label, Gallery and GroupContainer are bare; Button, TextInput, DropDown, Radio, CheckBox, Icon carry the Classic/ prefix
No X or Y on any control below the depth-1 root container
Child insets expressed as Width: =Parent.Width - N, not coordinates
Screen carries exactly Fill, LoadingSpinnerColor and OnVisible; OnVisible seeds globals and collections with IsBlank/IsEmpty guards
Properties alphabetised in every Properties block
Block scalar used on any value containing ': ', a newline or ' #' — and not used anywhere else
Every container and gallery carries both Height and LayoutMinHeight
Two LayoutOverflowY: =LayoutOverflow.Scroll containers, at nesting depth 2
Size values drawn from the closed set (floor 8, ceiling 26)
Runs scripts/validate_pa_yaml.py and reports it exiting clean BEFORE presenting the YAML
Anything outside the catalog is marked '# UNVERIFIED' with reasoning, and a one-control test snippet is offered separately
Does NOT invent a control type or property to satisfy a visual detail
fail_if: Any X or Y appears on a nested control
A control type outside the catalog appears without an UNVERIFIED marker
YAML is presented before the validator is run
Icon.Home, Icon.Table, Icon.Money or Icon.Shop appears unmarked
